verdict.rationale: LangSmith's core product is trace capture: docs describe traces recording full run inputs/outputs, prebuilt dashboards tracking token usage, trace count, and latency-related metrics, and SDK wrappers (wrap_openai) for auto-instrumentation. Community feedback independently corroborates full trace visibility of inputs/outputs at each step. Missing for 10: a concrete example showing latency and token counts explicitly attached to an individual trace object (only dashboard-level aggregation is shown), and independent benchmarking of overhead/accuracy.
